output.reason: Localized itchy blistery rash on both forearms after poison ivy contact, with no fever and no breathing trouble reported, fits self-managed contact dermatitis with over-the-counter care and clear return triggers.
output.patientMessage: You can start home care now: cool compresses, an over-the-counter hydrocortisone cream, and an oral antihistamine for itch; wash clothing and tools that touched the plant. This pattern fits a poison ivy reaction and usually settles over one to three weeks. Message a clinician here if the rash spreads well beyond your forearms, reaches your face or genitals, becomes painful, warm or pus-filled, or you develop fever.
differential: Allergic contact dermatitis from urushiol (poison ivy)
